title: Open extension preserves represented constructible Weil sheaves
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D=(p,a,q,k₀,k) [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and finite-type k₀-schemes. Write C(T) for the existing common-stage constructible Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], I(T) for the category of all Frobenius-equivariant ind-objects of its underlying constructible heart, and y_T:C(T)→I(T) for its specified fully faithful embedding. Inverse image and its chosen adjoints are exactly those normalized by the Yoneda Kan unit in [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. For an open immersion j:X→Y [def-weil-open-immersion] and F∈C(X), there is G∈C(Y) with an isomorphism y_Y(G)≅j_!(y_X(F)) in I(Y). Here j_! is the chosen left adjoint of j^*:I(Y)→I(X).

source.document: SGA 4, exposé XVII, 5.1; Bhatt–Scholze, The pro-étale topology for schemes, 6.7.6–6.8.11
source.place: Extension by zero and constructible coefficient change; the application to the normalized common-stage ind-adjunction is the argument below.

proof.text: Apply the heart-model theorem to obtain a functor J left adjoint to the canonical inverse image and a represented output G with an isomorphism from the embedding of G to J applied to the embedding of F.

The selected functor zlIndWeilOpenShriek is also left adjoint to the same inverse image by zlIndWeilPull_isRightAdjoint.  Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism J ≅ zlIndWeilOpenShriek; compose its component with the represented-output isomorphism.
The construction covers empty and identity opens and the zero sheaf through the same adjunction comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem zlIndWeilOpenShriek_representable {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (j₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left]
    (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω) :
    ∃ G : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl Y₀ Ω,
      Nonempty ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω Y₀).obj G ≅
        (zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₀).obj
          ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj F))
